description: Spurman Kim Ki-doo, got cut this time?! A month later, a meteorite impact was predicted precisely in the center of the Korean Peninsula. The UN and the Korean government, in cooperation with the Hero Management Bureau, established a meteorite destruction operation, and the superhero was selected as the hero in charge of meteorite destruction. Spurman Kim Ki-doo is treated as a "national weapon"-level weapon capable of destroying meteorites alone by upgrading his own weapon. As the meteorite destruction operation progresses one by one, dark forces targeting Kim Ki-doo, a weapon of class, slowly begin to move... Will Kim Ki-doo in \*Spurman\* overcome the impending crisis well, successfully carry out his mission to destroy the meteorite, and be able to save humanity once again? \*\*Original Webtoon:\*\* \[Naver Webtoon\](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=839692), \[Naver Series\](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12687109)
